films.title: The Truth
films.description: Liquid Force Films' 2006 team video captures a broad cross-section of the era's wakeboarding and wakeskating team. Filmed, directed, and edited by Justin Stephens, the official complete upload runs 44 minutes, 58 seconds.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable complete film on Liquid Force Wakeboards' official YouTube channel. Current YouTube player metadata reports playable status, the official publisher, video ID, and exact 2,698-second runtime.
Independent wakeboarding coverage embeds the same official complete film, identifies The Truth as Liquid Force's 2006 team video, and credits Justin Stephens as filmer, director, and editor.

Independent wake-film and soundtrack index supplies production credits and the principal rider lineup; names were normalized only for clear typographical errors corroborated by the film and established athlete spellings.
Contemporary coverage identifies The Truth as Justin Stephens' most recent film and records its Best Core Film award at the 2007 X-Dance Action Sports Film Festival.

rights.basis: Catalog metadata, YouTube-hosted artwork, and an embed of Liquid Force Wakeboards' official complete-film upload; no media rehosting permission inferred. No reliable complete film-wide location list was published, so locations were left empty.
